what: A large phrase pinned at screen center turns on in .5s (scale 1) when the top edge of its parent section (a long empty section) reaches 33% of the screen, and grows to 1.1x and turns off once the bottom edge passes 66%. Scrolling back up and re-entering turns it on at 1, and leaving above the section shrinks it to .7x and turns it off — each time the running tween is cut and a new one started, so the size doesn’t pile up even when going back and forth quickly

options.trigger: Reference section css — default is the parent element (a long empty section where the text is placed with position: fixed)
options.from: Scale it shrinks to when exiting upward, default .7
options.pre: Starting size, default 1 — the original only turns on at full size on first entry. With .7 the first appearance also grows as it turns on

use: Your big phrase here

from.where: index.html .sd-about__copy — in the original .about-wrapper(175rem) ScrollTrigger callbacks at top 33% · bottom 66%, .copyText gets killTweensOf and then an opacity · scale tween of .5s (enter 1·1, leave 0·1.1, enterBack 1·1, leaveBack 0·.7)
